column1: # Surname probes run against the 11,581 DNA matches of a living granddaughter of Pablo Armando,
# *** ON PRIVACY. *** Every DNA match is a LIVING person. Not one is named here, or on the page.
# Where a match's TREE is read, the people named from it are their DECEASED ancestors, which is
# what the research actually turns on. The line is: dead ancestors named, living matches not.
# *** CONTROL BEFORE NULL. *** Four control surnames were run in the same form, in the same
# session, before any null was believed. All four returned, and returned matches for whom the
# surname appears only inside their family tree. The search reaches trees. The nulls are real.
